title: DiscordWhitelisting
description: This plugin syncs your Minecraft server whitelist with a Discord bot, allowing users to request access via slash command. Moderators must approve all whitelist requests before they take effect.
body: This plugin combines the whitelist of your Minecraft server with your Discord bot to easily whitelist users via your Discord server using a slash command. The whitelist requests must first be approved by moderators before they are actually whitelisted. You can also identify the Players which are whitelisted so you know which Discord User is which Ingame Player.
